description: Record the **caller's review verdict** on the result of a turn that has **ended** (to allow or deny a permission request while a turn is running, use dsh_approval_decide). Results from dsh_send / dsh_interject and the sentinel carry a `review` ticket (checklist, evidence summary, review_id). Before treating a result as done, verify it yourself (read the changed files, look at git diff, run tests), then call this tool to record pass / partial / fail. **Reviews are advisory by default**: they do not block later dsh_send calls and are not fed back to DSH automatically; send another dsh_send if something needs fixing. A verdict can still be submitted after the run record was evicted from memory or the server restarted (the sentinel file is the reference).

conversation_id.description: Conversation id, from dsh_start or dsh_list.

findings.description: Optional itemised list of problems; up to 50 items of up to 2000 characters each.

notes.description: The reason. Required for fail/partial (or use findings instead). Up to 8000 characters.

run_id.description: The dispatch being reviewed (the run_id on the review ticket).

verdict.description: pass = usable as is; partial = partly usable, needs more work; fail = unusable, redo. fail and partial require a reason.

name: dsh_review
title: Submit review verdict
